Laurel Project Space is an artist-run art space which first opened on the ground floor of a former stable in the Jordaan, Amsterdam in May 2019. Existing as an extension of a shared studio, Laurel branches out as a communal project space, in which to host exhibitions, workshops and presentations. As of August 3rd 2020 we relocated to a new building in the each, on the Kamerlingh Onneslaan 1, which was previously a telephone operations centre.
